verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no automatic, per-pull-request code review with contextual feedback, so the verdict is none. The Diff Review feature lets you accept or reject the agent's own local edits, which is not PR review. The GitHub plugin gives the agent access to repositories and pull requests, but nothing shows reviews triggered automatically on every PR or feedback posted back to it. Automated review is a fair axis for an agentic IDE, so this is none rather than na.
